at_stake_amount.description: the priced value of open work still on `from_value`, the money the change would move

at_stake_currency.description: the currency of every amount on this record (`at_stake_amount`), an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code. A record with no currency has no usable amount. Present exactly when `at_stake_amount` is.

cause.description: the largest positive cost effect, or `bought` for a price set below the margin floor at decision time

currency.description: the currency of every amount on this record (`overrun_amount`), an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code. A record with no currency has no usable amount.

decided_at.description: when it was accepted or declined; required once `status` is not `proposed`

decided_by_user_id.description: who accepted or declined it; required once `status` is not `proposed`

evidence_fact_ids.description: the verdict facts the lesson rests on

from_value.description: the input's value the jobs were priced on

input_kind.description: the kind of input the change touches

jobs_counted.description: how many jobs priced on the input the median was taken over

overrun_amount.description: the overrun on the activity the lesson came from, in `currency`

project_entity_id.description: the project the lesson was raised from

proposal.description: the change in one line, as the estimating manager reads it

reason.description: why it was declined; required when `status` is `declined`

to_value.description: the proposed value: the median achieved across the jobs counted

weeks_in_breach.description: consecutive weekly runs the input has been outside the band

work_activity.description: the work activity whose input the lesson would change
